title: MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - BLUMENFIELD) relative to amending the 2026 Council Winter Recess schedule.
text:
[Council File 26-0001]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - BLUMENFIELD) relative to amending the 2026 Council Winter Recess schedule.
Recommendation for Council action:
AMEND the Council action of December 9, 2025 relative to the 2026 Council Recess Schedule (Council file No. 26-0001) to change the dates of the Winter Recess to Wednesday December 16, 2026 through Wednesday, December 30, 2026.
summary: Council motion to move the 2026 winter recess to December 16 through December 30, 2026.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 14, 2026); Council action final
